chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is'haq ibn Ammar, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) judged regarding the man who was struck upon his lower part, so he was no longer able to withhold his faeces nor his urine, that with regards to that is the complete wergild'.
ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for an injury causing incontinence of feces and urine?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), clarifies that the Amir al-Mu'minin (AS) ruled a complete wergild (diyah) for injuries causing incontinence of both feces and urine, highlighting the severity of losing control over major bodily functions. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes a precedent for valuing functional impairment over mere physical disfigurement, linking the compensation to the degree of permanent disability. The ruling underscores the principle that the loss of essential physiological control constitutes a significant injury warranting full compensation.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,
